ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page and URL
ideas.why:
Catalogue.jsx renders each mug as a bare

, so per-mug routes would give people and machines a direct address for each product.

ideas.idea: Add price, size and shipping details to the home page text
ideas.why: This is hedged advice that would apply to almost any shop and isn't tied to a specific gap in the code.
It's accurate and the page does state Bristol and handmade, but it is hedged on real prices and details that don't exist yet, so it is standard advice for any shop.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to index.html
ideas.why: index.html has only charset and title and no viewport tag, so mobile rendering is affected and the fix is a one-line change.

ideas.idea: Add an in-body link from Home to the catalogue
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no link onward to /catalogue, and the only nav entry is a button, so a body link would give crawlers and visitors a real path.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical URL once the domain is known
ideas.why: It is accurate and no canonical tag exists, but it is standard advice and the report leaves it as 'can't tell' pending the domain.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description, not just index.html's
ideas.why: The app has two routes sharing one static head, so per-route titles and descriptions would help distinguish them.
